Add the three y-coordinate equations: q+s+s+u+q+u = 2-2+4 = 4, that is, 2(q+s+u)=4, so q+s+u=2. Therefore p+q+r+s+t+u=(p+r+t)+(q+s+u)=3+2=5.

method.method_draft: Use direct midpoint equations for each side. First read the diagram to identify that M lies on side AB, N lies on side BC, and P lies on side AC. From the text, take A=(p,q), B=(r,s), C=(t,u), and midpoint coordinates M=(-2,1), N=(2,-1), P=(3,2). Apply the midpoint formula: (A+B)/2=M, (B+C)/2=N, and (A+C)/2=P. This gives six linear equations: p+r=-4, q+s=2, r+t=4, s+u=-2, p+t=6, q+u=4. Add the three x-equations to get 2(p+r+t)=6, so p+r+t=3; add the three y-equations to get 2(q+s+u)=4, so q+s+u=2. Therefore p+q+r+s+t+u=3+2=5.

method.method_draft: Use the vector-sum property of the three side midpoints. From the diagram, note that M, N, and P are the midpoints of AB, BC, and AC respectively. Let position vectors of A, B, C be a, b, c. Then M=(a+b)/2, N=(b+c)/2, and P=(a+c)/2. Adding these gives M+N+P=a+b+c, so the sum of the vertex coordinate vectors equals the sum of the midpoint coordinate vectors. From the text, M=(-2,1), N=(2,-1), P=(3,2), so A+B+C=(-2,1)+(2,-1)+(3,2)=(3,2). Hence the sum of all six vertex coordinates is 3+2=5.

再推理：设A(p,q)、B(r,s)、C(t,u)。由中点公式可得
M=((p+r)/2,(q+s)/2)=(-2,1)，
N=((r+t)/2,(s+u)/2)=(2,-1)，
P=((p+t)/2,(q+u)/2)=(3,2)。
把三式相加，左边变成

所以
A+B+C = (-2,1) + (2,-1) + (3,2) = (3,2)。
因此 p+r+t=3，q+s+u=2，所求
p+q+r+s+t+u = (p+r+t) + (q+s+u) = 3+2 = 5。
